title: The VHIE Evolution: Vermont's Blueprint for Data Interoperability
summary: An analytical review of the Vermont Health Information Exchange (VHIE) and its role in the Rural Health Transformation Program. This analysis explores the technical architecture required for real-time data liquidity across the Agency of Human Services.

children.text: As the Vermont Agency of Human Services oversees the VHIE, the shift from static data silos to dynamic exchange is the primary catalyst for state-level healthcare innovation.
II. Policy and Innovation Deep Dive

body.title: Podcast: The Future of the VHIE
body.summary: Chief Technology Officer perspective on integrating rural health providers into the statewide data fabric.

children.text: Interoperability is not a technical challenge; it is the economic architecture of shared clinical truth.

body.caption: Structural cost drivers in legacy HIE systems versus modern platforms.
